name: G7 Companion
author: Ian Swope
description: The latest Dexcom G7 glucose reading in the bar, read from Dexcom Share the way the Follow app does, with trend, age and a three-hour sparkline. For parents and partners following someone's CGM.

barWidget.description: Dexcom G7 reading, trend arrow and age. Goes grey when the reading stops updating. Click for the last few hours; middle-click to refresh.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: mg/dL or mmol/L. Thresholds below are always entered in mg/dL.

schema.label: Low (mg/dL)
schema.description: Below this the reading turns the theme's urgent colour. Match the low alert in the Follow app.

schema.label: High (mg/dL)
schema.description: Above this the reading turns amber. Match the high alert in the Follow app.

schema.label: Check every (seconds)
schema.description: The G7 posts every five minutes and Share lags the phone by a minute or two, so faster than 60 gains nothing.

schema.label: Grey out after (minutes)
schema.description: A reading older than this is drawn grey with its age, whatever its value.

schema.label: Show the trend arrow in the bar
Always show the reading's age in the bar
schema.description: Off shows the age only once the reading is stale.
